'''Chesmal Emry''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]. She is also [[Black Ajah]]{{ref/book|3|13}} and one of [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters]]

== Appearance and Personality==
She was from [[Ghealdan]]. Chesmal was stern but handsome with dark hair and eyes.{{ref/book|5|18}} She was tall for a woman and seemed even taller.{{ref/book|9|10}} She was 5'7 tall.

She was often described as cold and arrogant.{{ref/book|5|34}}{{ref/book|9|10}}{{ref/book|11|31}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Chesmal is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|24}}. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to [[Traveling|Travel]].

She had a strong [[Talent]] in [[Healing]]. Prior to [[Nynaeve]], Chesmal was considered among the most talented and best [[Healer]]s in Yellow Ajah anyone had seen in years, rivalling [[Samitsu]] and [[Suana]]. Her specialty was that she had the ability to manipulate all the electrical activity of the body. It is suggested that she might have rediscovered a non-standard form of Healing.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Chesmal Emry|comp}}

But Chesmal used her skills also to kill without leaving a sign on the corpses, in fact related to her Talent, she also possessed the rare ability to stop the heart of her victims.

== History ==
[[File:Chesmal Emry.JPG|thumb|left|Chesmal Emry from the CCG|200px]]She was born in the year {{ne|863}} and went to the Tower in {{ne|878}}. After spending seven years as Novice and six as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|891}}.{{ref||comp}} 

She was almost sent away twice as a novice and once as Accepted for severe infractions involving attacks on others.{{ref||comp}}  

Chesmal, along with [[Galina Casban]] and [[Jarna Malari]], was involved in the torture and murder of [[Tamra Ospenya]].{{ref/book|9|10}} She was also involved in the murder of [[Meilyn Arganya]], and she claimed to have manipulated the [[Red Ajah]] to murder [[Sierin Vayu]], because the Amyrlin was warned by [[Siuan]] about her activities. Chesmal often brags about her part in it to other Black sisters, and they thought that it would put her in danger from the [[Supreme Council]].{{ref/book|9|10}}{{ref/book|0|18}}

Chesmal enjoys embroidery, concentrating intently upon her work. She assumes everyone else approaches it in the same manner.{{ref/book|9|10}}

== Activities ==
After fleeing the [[White Tower]] with the other Aes Sedai of [[Liandrin]]'s Group, she went to [[Tear]] and worked for the [[Forsaken]] [[Be'lal]]. They tried to trap [[Rand al'Thor]] just after he released ''[[Callandor]]''.{{ref/book|3|13}}

When this failed, the group flees to [[Tanchico]] to try and steal the male ''[[a'dam]]'' from the [[Panarch]]'s Palace.{{ref/book|4|38}}{{ref/book|4|51}} This plan was foiled by [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].

After Tanchico they went to [[Amadicia]].{{ref/book|5|18}} There Liandrin tried to take advantage of a wounded [[Moghedien]], but the Forsaken was more able than her, leaving Liandrin severely punished, demoted and shielded permanently. [[Moghedien]] is shot with an arrow by [[Birgitte Silverbow]] in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', and it is Chesmal who heals her near-death injury.{{ref/book|5|34}} 

Upon leaving Liandrin's group, [[Moghedien]] placed Eldrith in charge, as the strongest in the [[One Power]] of the sisters remaining, ordering them to follow her to Ghealdan.{{ref/book|5|34}} 

So Chesmal and some of the other sisters travel to [[Samara]]. When [[Eldrith Jhondar]]'s [[Warder]] [[Kennit]] arrives, they flee to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|9|10}}

Though Moghedien has placed Eldrith in charge, Chesmal routinely disregards Eldrith's authority. After the Brown sister returns from an unexpected absence, Chesmal goes so far as to question her rudely about her activities.{{ref/book|9|10}} 

Chesmal is present with [[Asne Zeramene]] and Eldrith when [[Temaile Kinderode]] returns from spying on [[Elayne]], [[Egwene]], and Nynaeve in ''Tel'aran'rhiod''. Temaile makes her nervous because of the Gray sister's breaking of Liandrin.{{ref/book|9|10}}

[[File:Chesmal Emry.jpg|thumb|right|Chesmal Emry in the New Spring graphic novel.]][[Samwil Hark]] leads Elayne, [[Careane Fransi]], [[Sareitha Tomares]] and [[Vandene Namelle]] to the house on Full Moon Street where Chesmal, the other Black sisters and [[Mili Skane]] reside. After Vandene kills Careane when it is revealed she murdered [[Adeleas Namelle]] and [[Ispan Shefar]], Chesmal kills Vandene and Sareitha using the One Power.{{ref/book|11|31}} She and the others then attempt to kidnap Elayne, but are stopped by [[Birgitte Silverbow]] and a group of [[Windfinder]]<nowiki/>s. Chesmal and the others are held in the Royal Palace dungeon in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|11|32}}

Elayne sneaks into Chesmal's cell disguised as one of the [[Forsaken]] and questionsher  on her orders. Chesmal is deceived by the disguise, but she doen't divulge much of use to Elayna beore the interrogation is interrupted by Eldrith and Temaile. Elayne manages to shield all three women but is stabbed by [[Doilin Mellar]], thereby releasing Chesmal from her shield. Mellar demands Chesmal to Heal Elayne, which she does. Elayne hands her one of the copies of [[Matrim Cauthon]]'s [[Foxhead medallion]] which cuts her off from the Source. Elayne then sets Chesmal's clothing on fire, incinerating her.{{ref/book|13|24}}
